{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - apply 0.5-1.0 euro upward correction to match true outcomes",
    "True outcomes show clear mean reversion from extremes, pulling forecasts toward center",
    "High sentiment (positive) regions in forecasts need extra 0.3-0.5 euro boost to account for sentiment-driven price support",
    "Low sentiment (negative) regions are less problematic as prices have more floor support",
    "The forecast lag effect is most pronounced at 30-day horizons where noise and momentum compound",
    "When history shows strong upward momentum, model under-forecasts by 0.8-1.2 euros relative to true values",
    "Mean reversion rule: when forecast deviates >2 euros from historical mean, compress toward mean by 50% of deviation"
] }
